title: Profile
notes: Signed in only (Authorization: Bearer <token>; 401 otherwise). A user can read their account, change their name, and change their password. Changing the password signs out every other device; the one that changed it stays signed in. The shared demo accounts can't be changed (403), so one judge can't lock out the others.

errors.meaning: Empty name, or a new password under 8 characters

body.error: The new password needs at least 8 characters.

errors.meaning: Signed out, or the current password is wrong

body.error: Demo accounts are shared, so their name and password can't be changed.
